description: Tell us whether an Offer fits what the person asked for. This does not buy, reserve or pay.

expected_offer_version.description: The Offer version you last read.

note.description: Optional short private note for the person. Never include payment details.

request_key.description: Optional. The same key repeats a change safely; one is derived when left out.

verdict.description: fits: this Offer matches what the person asked for. does_not_fit: it doesn’t, and it stops counting for them.

name: respond_to_offer

demand.description: Derived demand state: potential (fits the outcome), validated (the buyer agent's latest pre-check of this exact Offer version said fits), needs_user (the agent must ask the user), committed (an authorized card payment, only on an Offer made while Popular Demand offered payment holds). not_counted means no current claim, never a refusal unless reasons say the agent declined. Price position is a label, never a gate.

title: Respond to an Offer
